mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_shopping_cart_items (user_id, uniform_id, size_id, recommendation_log_id, quantity, added_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{uniformId}, #{sizeId}, #{recommendationLogId}, #{quantity}, #{addedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_shopping_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND uniform_id = #{uniformId} AND size_id = #{sizeId}

SELECT sci.*, su.name as uniform_name, su.price as uniform_price, su.image as uniform_image, ss.size_name as size_name_display FROM s_shopping_cart_items sci LEFT JOIN s_uniform su ON sci.uniform_id = su.id LEFT JOIN s_sizes ss ON sci.size_id = ss.id WHERE sci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sci.added_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_shopping_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
